title: Notebook panels and rows grow to fill spare height
observed: At 0aa8ebcf the NEW NOTE panel stretches to about 760px on the 1024x1366 tablet with its controls at the top and empty surface below; on phone it carries about 50px of dead space under its button, and an isolated note row fills the whole 844px scenario cell. Col lowers to flexGrow 1 by default (Docs/Spec/Tao Layout and UI.md:706), and the starter never opts its panel or rows out.
impact: The first screen of a phase-1 starter looks broken on a tablet and loose on a phone; a newcomer copying the starter inherits the pattern.
expected: The NEW NOTE panel and each note row are only as tall as their content at every captured size.
recheck: recapture Notebook and inspect devices/phone, devices/tabletDark and both notes states cells.
notes: The `panel` and `card` bundles in Notebook, Pantry and the creation template now start with `hug`, which turns off Col's default growth and keeps its cross-axis stretch. Local captures on 2026-10-03 showed the new-note panel and each row at content height on phone and tablet, and an isolated row no taller than its content.
